reason: My NRO balance is under 5 lakh and I only go to India every couple of years, so I'm in no rush. I'd post this in our community WhatsApp group first, and unless a few people there had used it and vouched for it, I wouldn't move money through a company I've never heard of.
objection: CAD $79 to $199 is a lot when my Indian bank charges a few hundred rupees, and I don't know anyone who has used this. I'm not handing my savings to a stranger.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three people in my community or temple group saying they used it and the money arrived, plus a fee under about CAD $50 for my small balance.
